description: SYNTHORA space-weather: live space weather from NOAA SWPC — GOES X-ray flux (solar flare activity), solar wind plasma (speed and density) and planetary Kp geomagnetic index. Optional focus: send xray, wind or kp in the input to get just that series, otherwise the latest reading of all three. Source: services.swpc.noaa.gov, keyless, timestamped. $0.01 USDC on Base. [x402: 0.01 USDC per call on Base]
name: space-weather
